label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
Right Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

Got a wee extra surprise planned for Gran’s birthday weekend and I’m absolutely buzzing to tell you!

Morag’s said I can have Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Rd all to ourselves on Saturday 12 December, the afternoon before Gran turns 80 on the Sunday. She shuts at 12 on a Saturday, so we’ll have the place from 1pm to get everyone looking lovely before dinner.

And the best bit — I’m doing everyone’s hair for free. That’s me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran and the two wee ones. Seven heads to get through, so we’ll make a proper afternoon of it! Cuts and blow-dries are no bother for everybody, and Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray. They’ll be in their element.

If you fancy a colour, **please let me know what you want by Friday 27 November** so I can order everything from the wholesaler. Don’t just tell me “the usual” when you walk through the door! Send me what you’re thinking, even a photo if that’s easier, and I’ll sort out who’s getting done when.

Gran said at Easter she’d “love to go silver properly” but wouldn’t pay salon prices, so I’d love to see if we can make that happen for her. I’ll need to chat it through with her once she’s in on the surprise, mind!

Mum, can you get her there for 1pm without giving the game away? You’re our best bet for that. Keep this tucked away from her till then!

Bring a bottle of fizz and we’ll have a laugh while we get ready. Morag’s happy with that as long as we tidy up afterwards. Linda, at least this time your cooker and the dog will be safely out of splashing distance 😂

Dinner’s booked for 8.30pm that night at the Italian place on Byres Rd — nine of us, including Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man.

Can’t wait. Our Gran deserves a proper fuss ❤️ xxx
